Net GST Collection (Collection Minus Refunds)

Source: R/collection.R
gst_net_collection.Rd

Computes net monthly collection by subtracting gst_refunds from gst_statewise for overlapping FYs (2020-21 onwards).

gst_net_collection(
  financial_year = NULL,
  state = NULL,
  by = c("state", "region", "national")
)

Arguments

financial_year

character vector. NULL = all overlapping years.

state

character vector. NULL = all states.

by

character(1). Grouping: "state" (default), "region", or "national".

Value

A data.table with financial_year, month, month_date, grouping column(s), gross, refund, net.

Examples

gst_net_collection(financial_year = "2023-24", by = "state")[order(-net)][1:10]
